signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story house frontage from the street; large trees partly obscure the left side but the facade, roof and lawn are visible.

provider_truck.evidence: No commercial work vehicles or trailers visible at the property.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is mowed and shrubs near the house are trimmed, but there is no crew, equipment or clearly commercial-grade bed work visible.

solar_panels.evidence: The visible roof slope shows plain asphalt shingles with no panels.

signals.notes: Small cream-sided cape-style home with a red front door and an American flag by the entry, set behind mature trees and a utility pole in the foreground; no vehicles in the driveway or at the curb.
